title: Python Try...Except
description: The 'try' block lets you test a block of code for errors. The 'except' block lets you handle the error.

challenges.title: Basic Try
challenges.exercise: Try to print an undefined variable 'x'. Catch the error and print 'Error'.

challenges.title: Specific Exception
challenges.exercise: Catch a NameError specifically and print 'Name Error'.

challenges.title: Else Block
challenges.exercise: Print 'Hello' in try, and 'No error' in the else block.

challenges.title: Finally
challenges.exercise: Print 'Final' in the finally block regardless of errors.

challenges.title: Raise Exception
challenges.exercise: Raise a TypeError if x is not an int. (Set x='hi'). catch it and print 'Caught'.
